notes: BMS paid $14B for Karuna's lead asset KarXT — a dual M1/M4 muscarinic agonist + trospium combination for schizophrenia. NDA had been accepted by FDA in Sep 2023; subsequently approved as Cobenfy in Sep 2024. Sell-side peak estimates at deal time ranged $3-6B reflecting CNS biology novelty (first non-D2 antipsychotic mechanism approved in decades). Single-asset CNS M&A at a meaningful premium to consensus.
selection_rationale: Recent (2023-2024), single-asset, CNS-small-molecule M&A with a clear lead asset and public deal terms. Most directly comparable to other Phase 3 / NDA-stage CNS small molecules.
source: BMS press release Dec 22 2023; Karuna SEC filings; FDA approval letter Sep 26 2024.
